title: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs
summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft are extending their full-stack collaboration to help organizations build, customize and deploy intelligent applications — from next-generation infrastructure on Azure to industrial systems and Windows PCs. At Microsoft Ignite, the companies are expanding access to Azure virtual machines powered by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, as well as adding customer availability to […]
title_es: NVIDIA y Microsoft expanden computación acelerada desde Azure a Windows
bajada: NVIDIA y Microsoft amplían su colaboración para llevar aceleración con GPUs desde Azure hasta PCs Windows, facilitando el desarrollo y despliegue de aplicaciones AI empresariales. Este movimiento democratiza el acceso a infraestructura de alto rendimiento.
bajada_en: NVIDIA and Microsoft expand their collaboration to bring GPU acceleration from Azure to Windows PCs, enabling enterprise AI development and deployment. This move democratizes access to high-performance infrastructure.

title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics's most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades. If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics and add to the upheaval […]
title_es: Matemático de Anthropic afirma probar hipótesis de Riemann con Claude
bajada: Levent Alpöge de Anthropic asegura haber probado la hipótesis de Riemann, uno de los problemas más difíciles de matemáticas, con ayuda de Claude. Si se verifica, marcaría un hito significativo en capacidades matemáticas de IA, aunque requiere validación académica.
bajada_en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims to have proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics' hardest problems, using Claude. If verified, it would mark a significant milestone in AI mathematical capabilities, though academic validation is pending.

title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
summary: Test using prompts with unique, trackable secrets proves that data doesn't stay private.
title_es: Investigación expone filtración masiva de datos en cadena de suministro AI
bajada: Un researcher plantó datos únicos rastreables en la cadena de suministro AI y encontró que se filtraban en múltiples puntos, demostrando un grave problema de privacidad. Hallazgo crítico para developers que trabajan con datos sensibles.
bajada_en: A researcher embedded trackable data in the AI supply chain and found it leaking at multiple points, exposing a critical privacy problem. Essential finding for developers handling sensitive data.

title: Combatting adversarial distillation
summary: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.
title_es: OpenAI detalla defensa contra extracción de capacidades de modelos
bajada: OpenAI presentó un enfoque multicapa para combatir la destilación adversarial, combinando entrenamiento, salvaguardas, detección y enforcement. Este trabajo es relevante para developers que trabajan con seguridad de modelos y protección contra ataques.
bajada_en: OpenAI unveiled a multi-layered approach to combat adversarial distillation, combining model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement. This work is relevant for developers working on model security and attack prevention.

title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
summary: Gemini spark on a space background
title_es: Google añade recuperación de herramientas a Gemini API
bajada: Google introdujo Tool Retrieval en la Gemini API, permitiendo que modelos seleccionen y ejecuten herramientas de forma más inteligente. Esta característica mejora la capacidad de los agentes AI para resolver tareas complejas.
bajada_en: Google introduced Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API, enabling models to intelligently select and execute tools. This feature enhances the ability of AI agents to solve complex tasks.

title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
summary: MedChemBench evaluates how well AI models interpret molecular structures, reason from experimental evidence, and select compounds in early drug discovery.
title_es: MedChemBench evalúa IA en descubrimiento de fármacos
bajada: OpenAI presentó MedChemBench, un benchmark que evalúa cómo los modelos AI interpretan estructuras moleculares y seleccionan compuestos en descubrimiento temprano de drogas. Relevante para researchers en química computacional y desarrollo farmacéutico.
bajada_en: OpenAI introduced MedChemBench, a benchmark evaluating how AI models interpret molecular structures and select compounds in early drug discovery. Relevant for researchers in computational chemistry and pharmaceutical development.

title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
summary: A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding.  The report is an update to the organization’s time horizon plot, which was widely…
title_es: METR actualiza gráfico clave sobre trayectorias de capacidades AI
bajada: El nuevo reporte de METR muestra que algunas capacidades AI continúan mejorando exponencialmente, aunque modelos tienen limitaciones en tareas que requieren juicio crítico comparadas con coding. Proporciona data relevante para entender dónde está la IA hoy.
bajada_en: METR's updated report shows some AI capabilities continue improving exponentially, though models lag in judgment-heavy tasks compared to coding. Provides relevant data for understanding current AI trajectory.

title: Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed and verified by AI
title_es: Arquitectura CPU Frostbite diseñada y verificada enteramente por IA
bajada: Frostbite es una nueva arquitectura de CPU diseñada, creada y verificada completamente por IA, demostrando capacidades de ingeniería de sistemas avanzadas. Significativo para entender aplicaciones de IA en hardware design.
bajada_en: Frostbite is a new CPU architecture entirely designed, created, and verified by AI, demonstrating advanced systems engineering capabilities. Significant for understanding AI applications in hardware design.

title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
summary: Signal is restricting the ability to take screenshots on Android and iOS devices in an effort to prevent AI agents from reading users' messages and other data. The agentic AI capabilities built into operating systems that analyze on-screen information to learn more about the user are "undermining Signal's ability to independently guarantee privacy," Signal president […]
title_es: Signal bloquea acceso de Gemini y Siri AI a capturas de pantalla
bajada: Signal implementó restricciones para evitar que agentes AI de Google y Apple accedan a información en pantalla, argumentando que socavan garantías de privacidad. Decisión importante que refleja tensiones entre funcionalidad AI y privacidad del usuario.
bajada_en: Signal implemented restrictions to prevent Google and Apple AI agents from accessing on-screen information, arguing it undermines privacy guarantees. Important decision reflecting tensions between AI functionality and user privacy.

title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
summary: Apple is working on its own AI agent that can perform a range of tasks for you, including browsing the web, working across apps, writing code, and calling services. That's according to a now-removed job listing spotted by Bloomberg, which said Apple is looking for an engineer to lead the creation of an agentic AI […]
title_es: Apple contrata ingenieros para construir su propio agente AI
bajada: Apple está desarrollando un agente AI propio capaz de navegar web, trabajar entre apps, escribir código y llamar servicios, según una oferta de empleo filtrada. Señala que Apple se enfoca en capabilidades agenticas competitivas.
bajada_en: Apple is developing its own AI agent capable of web browsing, cross-app integration, coding, and service calls, according to leaked job listing. Signals Apple's focus on competitive agentic capabilities.

title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
summary: President Donald Trump promised to put a "tremendous tax" on companies that build data centers outside of the US, even as states and cities around the country are placing restrictions on new applications to build them. "We're not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country," Trump said at a […]
title_es: Trump amenaza impuesto masivo para data centers de IA fuera de EE.UU.
bajada: El presidente Trump prometió gravar con impuestos altos a empresas que construyan data centers fuera de Estados Unidos, buscando mantener infraestructura AI doméstica. Podría impactar significativamente estrategias de expansión global de empresas tech.
bajada_en: President Trump threatened heavy taxes on companies building AI data centers outside the US to keep infrastructure domestic. Could significantly impact global expansion strategies of tech companies.

title: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
title_es: Hugging Face lanza Inkling 2 Mini para inferencia local
bajada: Inkling 2 Mini es un modelo ligero optimizado para ejecutarse en configuraciones locales sin sacrificar rendimiento significativo. Ideal para developers que necesitan modelos eficientes en edge computing.
bajada_en: Inkling 2 Mini is a lightweight model optimized for local deployment without significant performance loss. Ideal for developers needing efficient edge computing solutions.

title: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
title_es: Hugging Face presenta adaptadores para optimizar modelos
bajada: Los harness adapters permiten ajustar modelos existentes para mejorar rendimiento y reducir costos operacionales. Una solución práctica para developers que buscan optimizar modelos en producción.
bajada_en: Harness adapters enable fine-tuning existing models to improve performance and reduce operational costs. A practical solution for developers optimizing models in production.

title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
summary: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.
title_es: Hebbia mejora análisis financiero con GPT-4o Astra
bajada: Hebbia reportó mejoras en investigación financiera usando GPT-4o Astra, con ganancias en cobertura de fuentes, relevancia de citas y calidad de presentación. Demuestra aplicación práctica de modelos avanzados en finanzas.
bajada_en: Hebbia reported improvements in financial research using GPT-4o Astra, with gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality. Demonstrates practical application of advanced models in finance.

title: SoftBank’s Masayoshi Son Explored $1 Trillion Moonshot Buyout of SK Hynix
summary: SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son recently approached Wall Street institutions about financing a possible trillion-dollar buyout of memory chip giant SK Hynix, according to people familiar with the matter, though a spokesperson said he’s no longer actively considering such a deal.“SoftBank explores many opportunities, and this one is no longer under active consideration,” said a SoftBank spokesperson.
title_es: SoftBank exploró compra de SK Hynix por $1 billón
bajada: El CEO de SoftBank Masayoshi Son exploró una posible adquisición de SK Hynix por $1 billón, aunque ya no está bajo consideración activa. Refleja la carrera por asegurar capacidad de fabricación de chips crítica para IA.
bajada_en: SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son explored a potential $1 trillion acquisition of SK Hynix, though no longer actively considering it. Reflects the race to secure critical chip manufacturing capacity for AI.
